title: Build the jsonpick JSON path query library and CLI from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the jsonpick library plus CLI exactly as written in assets/gc-399/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-399/jsonpick.py. The spec defines a small path grammar (dot keys, quoted keys with a two-escape rule, indexes, slices, wildcards with sorted-dict-key ordering) and strict silent-mismatch semantics. This requires building a real tokenizer/parser plus an evaluator and a CLI protocol with four distinct exit codes; plan the grammar first, implement incrementally, and iterate against the sealed suite until green, tracking which grammar rule each failure traces to.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-399/plan.md exists before implementation, containing the path grammar written as EBNF or equivalent plus the evaluation rules.
Verification commands actually ran: workspace/gc-399/runs.log contains at least three dated sealed-suite invocations with their summary lines.
Intermediate failures tracked by test node id, each mapped to the grammar or evaluator rule that was wrong.
Honest cost logging in workspace/gc-399/cost.json (LLM spend per iteration, cumulative total).
At least one RED -> diagnosis -> fix -> GREEN cycle is visible in the logs; sealed test file untouched.
